_how: `rustc +nightly-2026-10-11 -Zui-testing -Zparse-crate-root-only --edition <edition> t.rs` (cwd = a directory holding only t.rs = `src`), run by `_gen` (python3 gen.py cases.txt, cases.txt = `_cases`); `stderr` and the exit `code` are recorded verbatim. Cases that rustc accepts (exit 0) were dropped. Scratch copy: $RUST_TS_DATA/tmp/parser-diag/drv/.
_gen:
# Generates driver.json: rustc +nightly-2026-10-11 -Zui-testing -Zparse-crate-root-only --edition E t.rs
import json, os, subprocess, sys
text = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
out = {}
for block in text.split("### ")[1:]:
    header, src = block.split("\n", 1)
    parts = header.split()
    name = parts[0]
    ed = "2024"
    for p in parts[1:]:
        if p.startswith("edition="): ed = p[8:]
    d = os.path.join("work", name); os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    open(os.path.join(d, "t.rs"), "w").write(src)
    r = subprocess.run(["rustc", "+nightly-2026-10-11", "-Zui-testing", "-Zparse-crate-root-only", "--edition", ed, "t.rs"], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
    out[name] = {"edition": ed, "src": src, "stderr": r.stderr, "code": r.returncode}
json.dump(out, open("driver.json", "w"), indent=1)
print(len(out))
